headline: Stop snacking, start rowing—break this Sunday pattern today
summary: Today you lock in three Huel meals and one 30-minute treadmill session to close your 0.91 kg weekly deficit gap.
details: Set fixed mealtimes for three Huel portions (breakfast, lunch, dinner) with zero snacking between—Sunday emotional eating ends now. Run 30 minutes on the treadmill this morning while you're strongest, or row 20 minutes if you prefer. This one day matters: you're gaining 0.15 kg/week when you need to lose 0.76 kg/week to hit 88 kg by June 2027—today's discipline compounds into 33.6 kg of progress.
